_meta.purpose: Additional Indian Standards to expand the pilot corpus beyond its original 45.
_meta.provenance_meaning: The IS number and title are taken from a public reference list of standards actually cited by Indian civil engineers. The scope and description text is written from the title and the standard's evident subject -- it is NOT copied from the standard, which is paywalled. Treat scope text as indicative, not authoritative.
_meta.why_this_shape: Retrieval embeds title + scope + description. A standard with a real number and title but a written scope is still genuinely useful for search, and is honestly labelled so nobody mistakes the scope for the published text.

standards.title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for aggregates, both coarse and fine, derived from natural sources and manufactured sources, for use in concrete.
standards.description: Governs the grading, quality and permissible deleterious content of aggregate used in concrete. Referenced by IS 456 for all concrete work.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Aggregates for Concrete - Part 1: Particle Size and Shape
standards.scope: This standard prescribes the methods of test for determining particle size distribution, flakiness index and elongation index of aggregates.
standards.description: Test method used to demonstrate that aggregate supplied under IS 383 meets its grading and shape requirements.

standards.title: Hardened Concrete - Methods of Test
standards.scope: This standard covers the methods of test for determining the compressive, flexural and split tensile strength of hardened concrete.
standards.description: The acceptance test for concrete strength on site. Cube and cylinder testing to this standard is normally a contractual requirement.

standards.title: Fresh Concrete - Methods of Sampling, Testing and Analysis - Part 1: Sampling
standards.scope: This standard covers the methods of sampling fresh concrete for testing, including sample size, frequency and handling.
standards.description: Defines how concrete samples are taken at the point of placement so that strength test results are representative.

standards.title: Concrete Mix Proportioning - Guidelines
standards.scope: This standard provides guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes to achieve specified strength, workability and durability.
standards.description: Used to design a concrete mix for a given grade and exposure condition. Works alongside IS 456 for structural concrete.

standards.title: Common Burnt Clay Building Bricks - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for common burnt clay building bricks used in buildings and structures.
standards.description: Specifies dimensions, compressive strength classes, water absorption and efflorescence limits for ordinary masonry bricks.

standards.title: Preparation and Use of Masonry Mortars - Code of Practice
standards.scope: This standard covers the preparation, proportioning and use of mortars for masonry construction.
standards.description: Governs mortar mix proportions and workmanship for brick and block masonry.

standards.title: Portland Slag Cement - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the manufacture, chemical and physical requirements for Portland slag cement made by grinding Portland cement clinker with granulated blast furnace slag.
standards.description: A blended cement offering improved sulphate resistance and lower heat of hydration, widely used in marine and mass concrete works.

standards.title: Sulphate Resisting Portland Cement - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for sulphate resisting Portland cement intended for use where concrete is exposed to sulphate attack.
standards.description: Specified for foundations in sulphate-bearing soils and for structures exposed to sulphate-rich groundwater or effluent.

standards.title: Masonry Cement - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for masonry cement intended for use in masonry mortar and plaster.
standards.description: A cement formulated for improved workability and water retention in mortars rather than for structural concrete.

standards.title: Concrete Admixtures - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for chemical admixtures added to concrete to modify its properties.
standards.description: Covers plasticisers, superplasticisers, retarders, accelerators and air-entraining agents used in concrete.

standards.title: Non-Destructive Testing of Concrete - Methods of Test - Part 1: Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity
standards.scope: This standard covers the determination of ultrasonic pulse velocity through concrete for assessing quality and uniformity.
standards.description: Used to assess in-situ concrete quality, detect voids and cracking, without cutting cores.

standards.title: Precast Concrete Pipes (With and Without Reinforcement) - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for precast concrete pipes, with and without reinforcement, for the conveyance of sewage, rainwater and drainage.
standards.description: Specifies classes, dimensions, strength and testing for concrete pipes used in drainage and sewerage works.

standards.title: Mild Steel and Medium Tensile Steel Bars and Hard-Drawn Steel Wire for Concrete Reinforcement - Part 1: Mild Steel and Medium Tensile Steel Bars
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for mild steel and medium tensile steel bars used as reinforcement in concrete.
standards.description: Plain round bars for concrete reinforcement. Referenced by IS 456 alongside IS 1786 for deformed bars.

standards.title: Hard-Drawn Steel Wire Fabric for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for hard-drawn steel wire fabric used as reinforcement in concrete.
standards.description: Welded wire mesh reinforcement, commonly used in slabs, pavements and precast elements.

standards.title: Bending and Fixing of Bars for Concrete Reinforcement - Code of Practice
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for bending and fixing of steel reinforcement bars in concrete construction.
standards.description: Governs bar bending schedules, hook and bend dimensions, and how reinforcement is fixed before concreting.

standards.title: Metallic Materials - Tensile Testing - Part 1: Method of Test at Room Temperature
standards.scope: This standard specifies the method for tensile testing of metallic materials and defines the mechanical properties determined at room temperature.
standards.description: The tensile test used to demonstrate that reinforcement and structural steel meet the yield and ultimate strength their standard requires.

standards.title: High Tensile Steel Bars Used in Prestressed Concrete - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for high tensile steel bars used in prestressed concrete construction.
standards.description: Specifies mechanical properties and testing for prestressing bars used in post-tensioned and pre-tensioned members.

standards.title: Ready Mixed Paint, Air Drying, Red Oxide-Zinc Chrome, Priming - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for ready mixed red oxide-zinc chrome priming paint for application to structural steel.
standards.description: The primer coat commonly specified for structural steelwork before finish painting.

standards.title: Classification and Identification of Soils for General Engineering Purposes
standards.scope: This standard covers the classification and identification of soils for general engineering purposes based on grain size and plasticity characteristics.
standards.description: The soil classification system used in Indian geotechnical practice, underpinning foundation design and earthworks specification.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 4: Grain Size Analysis
standards.scope: This standard covers the method for determination of the grain size distribution of soils by sieving and sedimentation.
standards.description: Determines particle size distribution, which drives soil classification under IS 1498 and suitability as fill.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 5: Determination of Liquid and Plastic Limit
standards.scope: This standard covers the determination of the liquid limit and plastic limit of soils.
standards.description: Atterberg limits, used with grain size to classify fine-grained soils and assess their behaviour with moisture.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 7: Determination of Water Content-Dry Density Relation Using Light Compaction
standards.scope: This standard covers the determination of the relationship between water content and dry density of soils using light compaction.
standards.description: The Standard Proctor test. Sets the target density for compacted fill in embankments and subgrades.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 10: Determination of Unconfined Compressive Strength
standards.scope: This standard covers the determination of the unconfined compressive strength of cohesive soils.
standards.description: A quick strength test for clays, used in preliminary foundation assessment.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 13: Direct Shear Test
standards.scope: This standard covers the determination of shear strength parameters of soil by the direct shear test.
standards.description: Determines cohesion and angle of internal friction, the inputs to bearing capacity and slope stability calculations.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 28: Determination of Dry Density of Soils In-Place by the Sand Replacement Method
standards.scope: This standard covers the determination of in-place dry density of soils by the sand replacement method.
standards.description: The site test used to verify that compacted fill has reached the density required by the specification.

standards.title: Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater - Part 1: Sampling
standards.scope: This standard covers the methods of sampling water and wastewater for physical and chemical examination.
standards.description: Defines how water samples are collected and preserved, including water used for mixing and curing concrete.

standards.title: Drinking Water - Specification
standards.scope: This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for drinking water, including acceptable and permissible limits for physical, chemical and bacteriological parameters.
standards.description: The reference specification for potable water quality in India, applied in water supply schemes and public procurement of drinking water systems.

standards.title: Plywood for Concrete Shuttering Work - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for plywood used as formwork or shuttering for concrete work.
standards.description: Specifies film-faced and plain shuttering plywood, including bond quality and number of reuses.

standards.title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Water Bars - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for PVC water bars used for sealing joints in concrete structures to prevent water passage.
standards.description: Waterstops used at construction and expansion joints in water-retaining structures and basements.

standards.title: Two Part Polysulphide Sealants - Part 1: Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for two part polysulphide based sealants used for sealing joints in building construction.
standards.description: Movement joint sealant specified in facades, expansion joints and glazing.

standards.title: Fibres for Use in Fibre Reinforced Concrete - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for steel and synthetic fibres used in fibre reinforced concrete.
standards.description: Specifies fibre geometry, tensile strength and dosage for fibre reinforced concrete in slabs, tunnels and precast.

standards.title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement - Part 1: Determination of Fineness by Dry Sieving
standards.scope: This standard covers the method for determination of fineness of hydraulic cement by dry sieving.
standards.description: One of the acceptance tests demonstrating that supplied cement meets the fineness its specification requires.

standards.title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement - Part 4: Determination of Consistency of Standard Cement Paste
standards.scope: This standard covers the method for determination of the consistency of standard cement paste.
standards.description: Establishes the water content used in the setting time and soundness tests for cement.

standards.title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement - Part 5: Determination of Initial and Final Setting Times
standards.scope: This standard covers the method for determination of the initial and final setting times of hydraulic cement.
standards.description: Setting time governs how long concrete remains workable after mixing; an acceptance test for supplied cement.

standards.title: Standard Sand for Testing Cement - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for standard sand used in testing the strength of cement.
standards.description: The reference sand used so that cement strength results are comparable between laboratories.

standards.title: Methods of Tests of Burnt Clay Building Bricks - Part 1: Determination of Compressive Strength
standards.scope: This standard covers the method for determination of the compressive strength of burnt clay building bricks.
standards.description: The acceptance test demonstrating that bricks supplied under IS 1077 meet their strength class.

standards.title: Sand for Masonry Mortars - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for sand used in masonry mortars.
standards.description: Specifies grading and permissible deleterious content for mortar sand, distinct from concrete sand under IS 383.

standards.title: Plain Hard-Drawn Steel Wire for Prestressed Concrete - Part 1: Cold Drawn Stress Relieved Wire
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for plain hard-drawn steel wire used in prestressed concrete.
standards.description: Prestressing wire for pre-tensioned concrete elements such as sleepers, poles and precast beams.

standards.title: Enamel, Synthetic, Exterior - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for synthetic exterior enamel paint for application over primed surfaces.
standards.description: The finish coat commonly specified over primed structural steelwork exposed to weather.

standards.title: Methods of Tests for Concrete Pipes
standards.scope: This standard covers the methods of test for concrete pipes, including hydrostatic, three-edge bearing and permeability tests.
standards.description: The acceptance tests demonstrating that pipes supplied under IS 458 meet their class requirements.

standards.title: Methods for Sampling of Clay Building Bricks
standards.scope: This standard covers the method of sampling clay building bricks for the purpose of testing.
standards.description: Defines lot sizes and sample numbers so that brick test results represent the consignment.

standards.title: Ready-Mixed Concrete - Code of Practice
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for ready-mixed concrete, including materials, production, transport, delivery and acceptance.
standards.description: Applies IS 456 requirements to concrete produced off site and delivered to the works.

standards.title: Concrete Batching and Mixing Plant - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for concrete batching and mixing plant, including accuracy of weighing and mixing efficiency.
standards.description: Specifies the plant used to produce concrete under IS 4926, including batching tolerances.

standards.title: Supersulphated Cement - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for supersulphated cement manufactured by intergrinding granulated blast furnace slag with calcium sulphate.
standards.description: A specialised cement with high resistance to sulphate and acidic environments.

standards.title: High Alumina Cement for Structural Use - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for high alumina cement intended for structural use.
standards.description: Rapid strength gain and refractory properties; used in specialised structural and high-temperature applications.

standards.title: Rapid Hardening Portland Cement - Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements for rapid hardening Portland cement, which attains higher early strength than ordinary Portland cement.
standards.description: Used where early formwork removal or rapid return to service is required.

standards.title: Methods of Sampling Hydraulic Cement
standards.scope: This standard covers the methods of sampling hydraulic cement for the purpose of testing.
standards.description: Defines how cement is sampled from bags, silos and bulk carriers so that test results represent the consignment.

standards.title: Method of Chemical Analysis of Hydraulic Cement
standards.scope: This standard covers the methods of chemical analysis of hydraulic cement, including determination of major oxide constituents.
standards.description: The chemical acceptance test for cement, covering lime saturation factor, alumina ratio and insoluble residue.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Aggregates for Concrete - Part 3: Specific Gravity, Density, Voids, Absorption and Bulking
standards.scope: This standard covers the methods of test for determination of specific gravity, density, voids, absorption and bulking of aggregates.
standards.description: Provides the aggregate properties needed for concrete mix design under IS 10262.

standards.title: Methods of Test for Aggregates for Concrete - Part 4: Mechanical Properties
standards.scope: This standard covers the methods of test for determination of aggregate crushing value, impact value and abrasion value.
standards.description: Strength and durability tests for aggregate, particularly relevant to pavement and heavy-duty concrete.
